description_en: Imports an image to the asset center and creates a scan task for the image
description_zh: 将镜像导入到资产中心并为该镜像创建扫描任务
name: PublicSyncAndCreateImageScanTask

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The information about the images to be imported to the asset center. This parameter is in JSON format and contains the following fields:

RegistryType: The type of the image repository. Valid values:
    - acr
    - harbor
    - quay
RepoId: The ID of the image repository.
InstanceId: The ID of the ACR instance.
RepoNamespace: The namespace of the image repository.
RegionId: The region ID of the image.
RepoName: The name of the image repository.
Digest: The digest of the image.
Tag: The tag of the image.
CreateTime: The timestamp when the image was created. Unit: milliseconds.
UpdateTime: The timestamp when the image was updated. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
要导入资产中心的镜像的信息。该参数为JSON格式，包含以下字段：

RegistryType：镜像仓的类型。取值：
    - acr
    - harbor
    - quay
RepoId：镜像仓的ID。
InstanceId：ACR镜像仓实例的ID。
RepoNamespace：镜像仓的命名空间。
RegionId：镜像的地域ID。
RepoName：镜像仓的名称。
Digest：镜像的摘要。
Tag：镜像的标签。
CreateTime：镜像创建的时间戳，单位为毫秒。
UpdateTime：镜像更新的时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: images

Data.description_en: The data returned when the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的数据

CanCreate.description_en:
Specifies whether you can continue to create scan tasks. Valid values:

true: You can continue to create scan tasks.
false: You cannot continue to create scan tasks.

By default, a maximum of 10 scan tasks can run concurrently. If the number of scan tasks exceeds 10, calls to this operation to create a scan task fail. You must wait for at least one of the existing 10 scan tasks to complete before you can create a new scan task
CanCreate.description_zh:
是否可以继续创建扫描任务。取值：

true：可以继续创建扫描任务。
false：无法继续创建扫描任务。

默认支持同时存在10个扫描任务，超过10个扫描任务时，使用本接口创建扫描任务会失败。您需要等待已有的10个扫描任务中有扫描任务完成后，才可以继续创建新的扫描任务

CollectTime.description_en: The timestamp when the image information was collected. Unit: milliseconds
CollectTime.description_zh: 采集镜像信息的时间戳，单位为毫秒

ExecTime.description_en: The timestamp when the scan task started to run. Unit: milliseconds
ExecTime.description_zh: 扫描任务开始运行的时间戳，单位为毫秒

FinishCount.description_en: The number of images that have been scanned
FinishCount.description_zh: 已完成扫描的镜像的数量

Progress.description_en: The progress of the scan task

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the scan task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The scan task was executed successfully.
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION: The image is in a region that does not support scanning
Result.description_zh:
扫描任务的执行结果。取值：

SUCCESS：扫描任务执行成功
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION：镜像在不支持扫描的地域

Status.description_en:
The status of the scan task. Valid values:

INIT: Initializing.
PRE_ANALYZER: Pre-analyzing.
SUCCESS: Execution succeeded.
FAIL: Execution failed
Status.description_zh:
扫描任务的状态。取值：

INIT：初始化中
PRE_ANALYZER：预分析中
SUCCESS：执行成功
FAIL：执行失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the scan task

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of images scanned

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
